newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity close to making disposals - FT.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity close to making disposals - FT.

text.p: Anglo-American engineering group LucasVarity Plc is expected to announce shortly the sale of one of its non-core British electrical businesses, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
The newspaper, citing an unnamed senior official, said the LucasVarity also hoped to sell its geared systems division soon.
It added that Britain's Rolls-Royce Plc was reported to be one of the companies interested in the unit.

Last month, LucasVarity said it would take a one-off charge of 130 million pounds ($212.4 million) for its planned disposal of 13 businesses, in addition to 120 million pounds ($196.1 million) of previously-planned restructuring costs.
The company was formed last year by the merger of Britain's Lucas Industries and Varity Corp of the U.S. ($1=.6119 Pound)
